DE_NOVO.DICA: When the AI picks one of these paths, the automation waits for the customer's next reply and decides again. With no reply by the deadline, it ends without sending anything. Each time costs one AI call.
DE_NOVO.QUANDO: Decide again when the AI picks
DE_NOVO.PRAZO: Wait for the next reply at most
DE_NOVO.DESCONHECIDO: A marked path no longer exists ({chave}). Unmark it.
DE_NOVO.COM_PASSOS: “{nome}” decides again, so it can't have steps. Remove its steps in the list.
DE_NOVO.TODOS: Leave at least one way out unmarked (a path or "None applies"), so the automation can move on.
DE_NOVO.VOLTAR: After the path, go back to wait at
DE_NOVO.NAO_VOLTA: Don’t go back: wait for the next reply here
DE_NOVO.DICA_VOLTA: When the AI picks one of these paths, the automation runs its steps and goes back to wait at the step chosen below. Each round waits for the customer again and costs the AI calls of the path’s steps.
DE_NOVO.VOLTA_FORA: The step chosen to go back to no longer works: pick an earlier “wait until” that waits for the customer.

LEITURAS.MENSAGENS_COM_RESPOSTAS: The latest customer and team messages
LEITURAS.ULTIMA_MENSAGEM: The message that started the automation
LEITURAS.CONVERSA: Channel, inbox, labels and status of the conversation
LEITURAS.CONTATO: Contact name and fields (never email or phone)
LEITURAS.ANEXOS: Photos, PDFs and voice notes the customer sent
LEITURAS.ANEXOS_NOVOS: Only the photos, PDFs and voice notes this step hasn’t read yet
LEITURAS.CARD: The card: title, stage, pipeline, status and fields
LEITURAS.NOTAS: The conversation's internal notes (in a text to the customer, the AI may repeat what they say)

CAMINHO.DICA: From 2 to 8 paths. When the conversation is unclear, the AI picks “None applies” instead of guessing.
CAMINHO.SEM_LETRA: The path name needs at least one letter.
CAMINHO.RESERVADO: “None” is already the path for when nothing applies. Pick another name.
CAMINHO.REPETIDO: There is already a path with this name.

CAMPO.DICA: The AI fills in only what is written in the conversation. If it is not there, the field stays empty and the history says so.

DESTINOS.SUGESTAO: Leave as a suggestion for the team to review
DESTINOS.GUARDAR: Just keep it, for a later step to use

CUSTO.MEDIA: About {custo} per run, on your account AI key.
CUSTO.PRIMEIRA: The cost shows up after the first run.
CUSTO.POR_MENSAGEM: This step runs for each customer message while the automation waits: each message is a paid call to the AI.

TESTAR.DICA: Runs on up to 3 conversations you can see and shows what it would do. Sends and saves nothing. Uses your account AI key.

AVISO.GATILHO_SEM_CONVERSA: This automation starts from a card. The test uses the most recent conversations you can see.
AVISO.NENHUMA_ENTRARIA: No recent conversation would enter this automation right now. The test uses the most recent ones you can see.

MOTIVOS.NADA_PARA_LER: There was nothing for the AI to read in this conversation. The AI was not called.
MOTIVOS.IA_INDISPONIVEL: The AI did not answer in time. Try again.
MOTIVOS.CHAVE_RECUSADA: The AI provider refused the account key. Check the key in integrations.
MOTIVOS.OUTRO: The AI could not answer for this conversation.

ANEXOS.LERIA: This conversation has no attachment for the AI to read. | The AI would read 1 attachment from this conversation. | The AI would read {n} attachments from this conversation.
ANEXOS.ANEXO_GRANDE_DEMAIS: An attachment in this conversation is too large for the AI. The AI is not called in this conversation.
ANEXOS.ANEXO_FORA_DO_FORMATO: An attachment in this conversation is in a format the AI cannot read. The AI is not called in this conversation.
ANEXOS.ANEXO_SEM_LEITURA: An attachment in this conversation cannot be read yet (a voice note without transcription or a file that did not arrive). The AI is not called in this conversation.
ANEXOS.MODELO_SEM_IMAGEM: The AI of this step cannot see photos or PDFs. The AI is not called in this conversation.
